01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dashboard with a coherent indigo accent, clean typographic hierarchy, and a clever dual-layer sparkline table, though the dense parallel coordinate lines risk visual overload and the region color legend is absent.
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.encoding_integrity_note: Per-axis Y scales use d3.extent (data-driven) and sparkline baselines are anchored at zero, but bins are hardcoded at 24 rather than derived via Sturges'/Scott's rule, and sparkline fg-bars lack key functions for stable object constancy on update.
flags: Stale Scale (no resize handler — x/y scales captured in module-level closure, never refreshed on viewport change)
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.stress_test_note: RAF coalescing correctly gates both brush and strum updates, pointer events API prevents mouse-touch double-fire, and the absence of D3 transitions eliminates mid-flight race conditions; the only weakness is stale x/y scales on window resize since there is no ResizeObserver or resize listener to recompute them.
01-parallel-coords-sparkline-table.cognitive_load_note: 6-color Paul Tol palette and alpha-layered canvas rendering manage 150-line density well, and the two-panel layout (parallel coords + summary table) stays coherent, but all-selected state in the screenshot produces a dense tangle where individual trajectories are unreadable without brushing.
